name: eccentric-only-pull-up
instructions:
1. Using a pronated grip, grasp the pull bar with a slightly wider than shoulder width grip.
2. Take a deep breath and hop to get yourself up to the bar. Squeeze your glutes, brace your abs, and descend slowly back to the start position.
3. Repeat for the assigned number of repetitions.
